200.description: The upstream answer to a keyed command, relayed unchanged.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value true, only when the answer is a replay of a stored one (any upstream write hop of the composition was replayed).

schema.description: A JSON document owned by the upstream contract; the BFF does not interpret it.
schema.title: Passthrough

400.description: A 400 problem: idempotency-key-required, idempotency-key-invalid, unknown-query-parameter, invalid-limit, invalid-cursor (relayed from the provider) or malformed-request.

404.description: An RFC 9457 problem. Upstream problems are relayed unchanged; the edge adds validation-failed, session-required, malformed-request, payload-too-large, upstream-unavailable (503), gateway-timeout (504) and internal-error.

409.description: A 409 problem relayed from the provider: a business conflict, or idempotency-key-reused when the same Idempotency-Key was sent with a different request (method, path or body). The BFF passes it through unchanged.

value.title: Idempotency-Key reused with a different request

422.description: An RFC 9457 problem. Upstream problems are relayed unchanged; the edge adds validation-failed, session-required, malformed-request, payload-too-large, upstream-unavailable (503), gateway-timeout (504) and internal-error.

503.description: An RFC 9457 problem. Upstream problems are relayed unchanged; the edge adds validation-failed, session-required, malformed-request, payload-too-large, upstream-unavailable (503), gateway-timeout (504) and internal-error.

504.description: An RFC 9457 problem. Upstream problems are relayed unchanged; the edge adds validation-failed, session-required, malformed-request, payload-too-large, upstream-unavailable (503), gateway-timeout (504) and internal-error.
